thread:
incident-bot: PAGER — metering.alerts.token-drift — multiple customers seeing sudden token-count spikes vs ledger (delta > 30%) · severity: P1 · runbook: metering/ghost-counts · link: https://ops.internal/alerts/1765432101 :rotating_light:

incident-bot: auto-assign -> @sre-oncall; paging window: 02:10-02:14Z

sre-oncall: I'm on it. grabbing recent shard logs and the ingestion consumer offsets.

billing-eng-carmen: saw similar on shadow aggregator last night, could be duplicate replays from the emitter. Will check emitter retries.

alice-r: quick heads-up — CS reported three customers received overage emails at 02:05Z. Not sure if false positives yet.

ben-m: pulling SQL: `SELECT sum(tokens) FROM metering.events WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-03-05 01:50' AND '2026-03-05 02:10' GROUP BY customer_id` — running now, will paste results.

sre-oncall: note: live dashboard shows gap between raw-emitter and billing-agg starting ~02:02Z, emitter > agg (weird). Could be duplicate ingestion causing emitter to oversend to billing.

ben-m: partial results — cust_A +420% tokens in that window, cust_B +340%, cust_C unchanged. Payloads show repeated `request_id` values for many events.

billing-eng-carmen: ok that points to upstream emitter duplicates. Checking Kafka consumer group lags and commit timestamps. `kafka-consumer-groups --describe --group metering-processor` shows multiple partition rebalances at 02:01Z.

sre-oncall: rebalances would cause at-least-once reprocessing if commits delayed. Are commits failing? logs: ```ERROR ConsumerCommit - commit failed: TimeoutException``` around 02:01:12Z

alice-r: can we flip to fallback dedupe? We have `ingest.dedupe=true` flag for emergency. Is it safe to toggle?

billing-eng-carmen: we have a hot flag `DEDUP_MODE=drop-duplicates` but it wasn't wired in the autoscaling path. I can flip, but it will increase CPU. OK to toggle for short window?

sre-oncall: do it. Toggle and watch. Carmen, please announce once toggled so we can monitor token inflow.

billing-eng-carmen: toggling now -> `kubectl set env deploy/metering-processor DEDUP_MODE=drop-duplicates -n prod` · applying... done. Restarting pods rolling. :white_check_mark:

ben-m: after dedupe flip, emitter vs agg delta dropping — cust_A down to +8% in next window. Looks like mitigation is working.

cs-liaison: starting customer outreach template for those who got alerts. Recommend 'investigating a false overage; don't bill yet' copy. Want approval to send.

alice-r: yes approve. Don't mark as billing-final. We'll reconcile once backfill completes. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: NOTE -> creating incident ticket INC-2026-1765432101 and assigning to metering oncall rotation.

sre-oncall: creating short postmortem checklist: 1) root cause: kafka commits timed out during partition rebalance; 2) gap: dedupe flag not in hotpath for rolling restarts; 3) mitigation: hotflag + customer hold; 4) follow-up: add commit retry/backoff and alert when commit RTT > 1s.

billing-eng-carmen: opening follow-up PR to wire dedupe into autoscaler startup, and add commit metrics to dashboard (consumer.commit.rt).

ben-m: I'll run ledger vs emitter reconciliation job for the 02:00-03:00Z window and write a delta report. Expecting a small set of customers to have transient excess counts — will include recommended credits.

cs-liaison: sending draft message to affected customers now, cc'ing legal. Keeping it conservative.

alice-r: thanks all. leaving the channel for now but will join postmortem. please add timeline notes as replies.

sre-oncall: monitoring for next 30m; if drift resurfaces we escalate to infra leads. For the record, commit timeouts coincided with a burst in cluster CPU from a scheduled model-build job in the same AWS ASG. Adding cross-team note.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: metering.alerts.token-drift — auto-resolve at 02:35Z after confirmed delta < 5% for 3 consecutive 1m windows. Incident ticket updated.

billing-eng-carmen: postmortem draft created: `metering/ghostwave-2026-03-05.md` with action items and owners. I'll link once ready.

ben-m: reconciliation job finished — attaching summary to INC ticket. Small subset (12 accounts) flagged; propose issuing credits for the window.

cs-liaison: notified customers and queued refunds/credits. Closing customer impact loop. :white_check_mark:

sre-oncall: thanks team — handoff complete. I'll forward to oncall rotation for follow-ups tomorrow.
